visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit retail shop where a man in a black and white plaid shirt is holding a round tin with a teddy bear illustration. Behind him are stacks of similar red cookie tins reaching almost to the ceiling. (2) A close-up shot shows a circular tin lid being opened on a dark tabletop to reveal a variety of flower-shaped butter and coffee cookies. (3) The camera cuts to an outdoor urban setting where the man stands in front of a white building sign that reads 'Jenny Bakery'. (4) A sequence follows the man walking through the busy streets of Tsim Sha Tsui, passing subway exits and jewelry stores under a cloudy sky. (5) The man enters a multi-story building called Mirador Mansion and walks up a staircase while holding a shopping bag. (6) Inside the crowded bakery, he presents different tin designs, including a round one and a square one with Christmas-themed teddy bear graphics, surrounded by a line of customers and shop staff behind a counter.
